integrity: The gamma Fourier coefficients, finite-graph off-diagonal signs, and spectral definition are acknowledged as established ingredients. New mathematical claims concern sharp central location, exact reflected endpoint norm, parity correction and logarithmic zero-order finite-size limit. Finite numerical checks are not claimed as proofs.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the unnormalized counting-measure path Laplacian and \(0<\alpha<1\). The two-term parity expansion is fixed-alpha; near zero a separate uniform estimate is proved. Independent historical-priority verification has not been performed.
title: Sharp fractional path-Laplacian norms, parity corrections, and a logarithmic crossover
